name: Tremors of the Earth
summary: Garek asks for your help after hearing all you have done for Sigrun. His master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, sent him to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. First, he needs the stolen Sign of the Earth.

sections.title: A Matter Kept Close
sections.body: Krasus of the Kirin Tor sent Garek to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. He cannot tell you the exact assignment, only that it matters greatly. Roving ogres took the Sign of the Earth, and Garek needs it back before he can tell you more. They are sometimes seen around Camp Boff.

sections.title: The Wandering Ogres
sections.body: Ogres wander from camp to camp across the Badlands. Rising heat and swirling winds make their trail hard to follow. Garek has heard they sometimes pass through Camp Boff, so look there if you lose track of them.

sections.title: Garek Explains
sections.body: When you return with the Sign, Garek tells you the Dark Iron dwarves of Angor Fortress made it to bind Deathwing's twin lieutenants, the ruthless Blacklash and Hematus.

faq.answer: Krasus of the Kirin Tor is Garek's master. He sent Garek to the Badlands to stop trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine.

faq.q: What is the Sign of the Earth?
aliases: what is the sign of the earth
faq.answer: Wandering ogres stole the Sign of the Earth, and Garek needs it back before he will tell you more.

faq.q: Where can the wandering ogres be found?
aliases: where is sign of the earth
faq.answer: The ogres roam between camps across the Badlands. Garek has heard they sometimes pass through Camp Boff.

faq.q: Why does Garek keep the assignment secret?
faq.answer: Garek will not share the assignment or what work it calls for. He says only that it matters greatly.
